component.name: pixpixpix
component.summary: Fast keyboard-first image and video viewer

description.p: pixpixpix puts the image you open on screen as fast as possible and lets you browse its folder with the arrow keys, with neighbours preloaded and a thumbnail band.

ul.li: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF and AVIF, animations and multi-image files
Videos, Apple Live Photos and Motion Photos through libmpv, with frame stepping
A directory column and an overview gallery across all subfolders
Rotate, trash, copy and open in another app with one key
Arrows, text, shapes, pixelation, crop and exact-size export behind one save dialog
A metadata view that fixes capture dates and removes location or all EXIF

description.p: This bundle includes libmpv, which makes it GPL licensed; pixpixpix itself is MIT.
